newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks up sharply on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks up sharply on U.S. data.

text.p: French stocks up sharply on smaller-than-expected U.S. trade deficit for April and higher than expected jobless claims.
Investors waiting for Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's keynote policy speech expected to begin in a few minutes.
* CAC-40 index up 30.07 points, or 1.09 percent, at 2,781.81 at 1300 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures contract up 28 at 2,777
